claim: Emotion / conversational tone CAN be driven acoustically in chatterbox via the base ChatterboxTTS exaggeration + cfg_weight controls; the Turbo engine currently wired into persona-dream ignores them.

method.engine: chatterbox.tts.ChatterboxTTS (base model), inside container chatterbox-fork-agent-server, /usr/bin/python3.11, torch 2.6.0+cu124, cpu
method.generate_signature: generate(text, repetition_penalty=1.2, min_p=0.05, top_p=1.0, audio_prompt_path=None, exaggeration=0.5, cfg_weight=0.5, temperature=0.8)
method.controls_for_confound: fixed text + torch.manual_seed(1234) before every generate, so exaggeration/cfg_weight are the ONLY variables
method.text: I already told you where I stand. Do not ask me again.
method.measurement: torch (rms/f0) AND independent stdlib wave+audioop read-back; both agree to 0.01 dB

positive_signal.duration_shortens: 3.92 -> 3.32 -> 2.76 s as exaggeration rises 0.3 -> 0.8 (speech rate rises); intense 2.96 s
positive_signal.distinct_audio: all 4 wav sha256 differ - genuinely different renders, not a cached/identical response
positive_signal.f0_note: f0 mean/range is noisier (crude detect_pitch_frequency, differing voiced-frame counts); loudness+duration are the clean, defensible deltas

negative_control_turbo_engine.meaning: the engine persona-dream currently renders through self-declares the emotion knobs as ignored; raw contract saved as turbo_presets.contract.json

conclusion: PROVEN: emotion/tone is a real, measurable acoustic control in chatterbox through base-model exaggeration/cfg_weight. It is dead through the Turbo service. Next step for persona-dream: route the affect->voice bridge to a base-ChatterboxTTS render path and map arc_state/mood intensity -> exaggeration, valence -> cfg_weight.
